The Enchantment Guide

There are 12 custom enchants.

This guide will help with:
- Creating
- & Using
each enchantment.

(Note: No custom enchantment can be stacked).

Agility (I-II):
Gain +20% Speed per level. Sword only.
This can stack with itself using your mainhand or offhand.

Ingredients:
Rabbit's Foot, Sugar, Gunpowder, Book

Use a firework on the dropped items to craft.

Aquatic (I-V):
Gain +2 atk in water per level. Applies on any sharp weapon + trident.

Ingredients:
Prismarine Shard, Prismarine Crystals, Lapis Block, Glow Ink Sac, Book

Throw a trident at ingredients to craft.

Counter (I-II):
Upon getting hit, time a hit back to apply debuffs. Axe only.

Ingredients:
Shield, Cactus, Golden Sword, Netherite, Clock, Book

Throw ingredients in an end crystal to craft.

Disorientate:
Have a 10% chance to rotate enemy upon hit. Axes only.

Ingredients:
Pufferfish, Chorus Fruit, Suspicious Stew, Wither Rose, Closed Eyeblossom, Book

Throw ingredients whilst with nausea'd entity to craft.

Endurance (I-III):
Gain lvl resistance if not hit for 4 seconds. Shields only.

Ingredients:
Brick, Resin Brick, Gold, Iron, Copper, Nether Brick, Book

Throw ingredients in the deep dark to craft.

Entrapment:
While blocking, have a 14% chance to summon cobwebs on the opponent. Shields only.

Ingredients:
String, Cobweb, Spider Eye, Fermented Spider Eye, Soul Sand, Book

Throw ingredients in cobwebs to craft.

Final Stand:
While under 2.5hp, gain 15 atk + resist 3. Use on any sharp weapon.

Ingredients:
Ender Eye, Blaze Rod, Golden Apple, Chorus Flower, Respawn Anchor, Sculk Shrieker, Book

Throw ingredients in the end to craft.

Knockout:
Knock the opponent down on crit. Axes only.

Ingredients:
Anvil, Chipped Anvil, Damaged Anvil, Book

Throw items midair to craft.

Snap:
Hit opponent to disable their and your harmful projectiles. Axes only.

Ingredients:
Netherite Scrap, Tipped Arrow, Arrow, Spectral Arrow, Fire Charge, Pearl, Book

Throw items on bedrock to craft.

Strengthen (I-II):
Gain +3 atk per level with strength. Applies on any sharp weapon.

Ingredients:
Blaze rod & powder, Fire Charge, Gundpowder, Dragon Breath, End Crystal, Flint and Steel, Book

Drop items in strength effect cloud to craft.

Target (I-III):
Hit the same mob twice to apply nerfs and gain buffs. Applies on any sharp weapon.

Ingredients:
Target, Breeze Rod, Blaze Rod, Crossbow, Book

Shoot a spectral arrow at items 20 blocks away to craft.

Potion (I-III):
Have a chance to apply a random potion effect upon hit. Swords only.

Throw items in water cauldron with your weapon to enchant. The following ingredients are on the next page.

Potion I Ingredients:
Rotten Flesh, Glass Bottle, Spider Eye, Ink Sac, Nether Wart

Potion II Ingredients:
(Requires Potion I)
Rotten Flesh, Glass Bottle, Spider Eye, Ink Sac, Nether Wart, Redstone, Fermented Spider Eye, Glistering Melon Slice, Resin Clump

Potion III Ingredients:
(Requires Potion II)
Rotten Flesh, Glass Bottle, Spider Eye, Ink Sac, Nether Wart, Redstone, Fermented Spider Eye, Glistering Melon Slice, Resin Clump, Glow Ink Sac, Closed Eyeblossom, Pufferfish, Sugar, Sponge, Honeycomb, Glowstone Dust, Echo Shard, Rabbit Stew...

...Wither Rose, Netherite Scrap, Breeze Rod

%Chance increases
with 10(1+X)% where X
= level.






End of Guide.
